about: PAT16 of OpenNeuro ds001226 (CC0), two-tensor UKF, the case library's stored result (Contents/data/tractcloud/cases/PAT16.json, 2026-10-01). The regression test (cases.regression.test.ts) reruns the case and compares; a deliberate change that moves these numbers rewrites this file in the same commit, with the reason. Rewritten 2026-10-01 night: the seed's FA computed as the original UKFTractography does for the simple model (the mean of the two minor eigenvalues; ukf.ts), which tracks fewer seeds -- from the same seeds the port now tracks the same seeds as the original (838 fibers each). Rewritten 2026-10-02: whole-brain seeds start only inside the brain (DIPY's median_otsu mask; the head mask put a third of them in the scalp), 16,000 of them (25,000 before; about the same count of streamlines); tracking still runs inside the head mask (median_otsu cuts the top of the brain); and the tracker's constraint projection is exact (the card's too). Judged against the noise floors (agreement.ts), the near-tumor list changed as much as a new seed draw changes it.
